title: Oven-Roasted Turkish Pistachio Kunefe
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring layers of crispy pastry, sweet cheese, and chopped pistachios, perfect for special occasions

ingredients.name: sharps kravtsov cheese
ingredients.notes: crumbly, low-fat cheese, available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

ingredients.name: rose water
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern grocery stores

instructions: Combine yeast, warm water, and a pinch of sugar in a small bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes, until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and cinnamon. Add the yeast mixture, honey, and melted butter. Mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, until doubled in size.
While the dough is rising, prepare the cheese mixture. In a separate bowl, combine cheese, rose water, and vanilla. Mix until smooth.
Punch down the dough, and divide it into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thin sheet, about 1/8 inch thick.
Brush the sheets with melted butter, and layer them in a ceramic tagine or a 9x13 inch baking dish. Repeat the layers until all the dough and cheese mixture are used up.
Sprinkle the chopped pistachios over the top layer of dough.
Cover the tagine with plastic wrap, and bake for 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tagine from the oven, and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Dust the kunefe with confectioners sugar, and serve warm.
Serve the kunefe with a drizzle of honey, if desired.
